title.narrative: Education Reform Strategy (2025 – 2035) was developed with support of UNICEF and EU. As a milestone document, it provides a roadmap of reforms for improving the quality, equity, school infrastructure, governance, and financing of education in systemic and sustainable manner. Progress was made in inclusive and digital education.;
